The execution was successful with a perfect reward (1.0). The model correctly implemented complex Excel formula injections (INDEX/MATCH, SUMPRODUCT, and statistical functions) across multiple blocks. 

Key pattern for success:
1. Strict adherence to the 'Inspect-Write-Validate' cycle allowed the model to handle dynamic range boundaries in the 'Data' sheet.
2. Use of absolute column/row references ($D{row}, {col}$10) in the formula generation logic ensured the formulas remained robust across the 6x5 blocks.
3. Row-label verification in the summary statistics block (MIN, MAX, MEDIAN, etc.) prevented errors in row-to-function mapping.
